short-plan.plan:
1. Add `GET /invoices/:id/pdf` to the API.
2. Add the download button to the invoice drawer.
3. Write tests for both and run the suites.

long-plan.plan:
## Goal
Every invoice gets a PDF download.

## Steps
1. **API** — add `GET /invoices/:id/pdf`. Stream the file from S3 with the billing role.
   - 404 when `pdf_key` is null
   - 403 for another account's invoice
2. **Worker** — backfill statements for seeded invoices:

```bash
python -m worker statements --missing-only
```

3. **Web** — a download button in the invoice drawer, disabled while the statement renders.
4. **Tests** — API (happy path, missing file, foreign account), UI (button and error toast).

## Risks
- The bucket policy in `infra/storage.tf` is wider than it should be; I will not touch it in this change.
- Rendering is slow for accounts with more than 500 meters.

## Out of scope
Emailing the PDF.

3. **Web** — a download button in the invoice drawer, disabled while the statement renders.
4. **Tests** — API (happy path, missing file, foreign account), UI (button and error toast).

launch-plan.title: Give every customer a launch plan
launch-plan.summary: Turn a won deal into an owned, dated plan—and show what changes when a milestone slips.

external_actions.explanation: This rehearsal is limited to local changes and verification.

items.title: Launch plan data & API
items.criteria: A won deal creates an owned plan; existing accounts remain intact.

items.title: Dependencies & impact preview
items.criteria: A three-day slip previews affected successors before applying changes; dependency cycles are rejected.

items.title: Launch workspace
items.criteria: Owners can manage tasks without bypassing required work.

items.title: Interactive timeline
items.criteria: Dates match the workspace after a schedule change.

items.title: Portfolio attention
items.criteria: Teams can find overdue launches with correct access boundaries.

items.title: Versioned launch templates
items.criteria: New launches use the chosen version; existing plans are unchanged.

items.title: Local reminders
items.criteria: Due-date changes update in-app reminders without duplicates.

items.title: API & permissions
items.criteria: Tests cover tenant boundaries, roles, completion rules, and scheduling.

items.title: Browser journey & evidence
items.criteria: The full journey passes with screenshots attached to board items.

items.title: Upgrade & regression
items.criteria: Existing data survives and the previous journey still works.

items.title: Accept the complete journey
items.criteria: Win a deal, adjust a milestone, verify affected views, and complete the plan.

security-plan.title: Close the staging exposure gaps
security-plan.summary: Assess the approved staging targets, prepare fixes, and independently recheck the findings.

actions: Open remediation pull requests in acme/billing-service
external_actions.explanation: Only the staging targets named in the request are in scope. Active scans contact external systems.

items.title: Assess repository findings
items.criteria: Findings identify affected code and include reproducible evidence.

items.title: Assess staging exposure
items.criteria: Checks stay within the approved staging targets and report coverage gaps.

items.title: Prepare remediation changes
items.criteria: Each proposed fix references its finding and includes regression coverage.

items.title: Accept independently verified findings
items.criteria: Reported vulnerabilities no longer reproduce; unresolved risks remain explicitly documented.

marketing-plan.title: Prepare the customer launch campaign
marketing-plan.summary: Research the audience, create campaign drafts, and review claims before publication is considered.

exclusions: Publishing before the user chooses channels and approves the copy
external_actions.explanation: Publication channels and recipients have not been selected. Clarification is needed before any publishing or sending.

items.title: Audience and message brief
items.criteria: The brief identifies the audience and cites sources for factual claims.

items.title: Campaign drafts
items.criteria: Drafts match the approved brief and make no unsupported claims.

items.title: Review campaign assets
items.criteria: Claims, tone, and links are checked; publication requires a separate decision.

items.title: Add GET /invoices/:id/pdf
items.criteria: Returns the stored PDF for the caller's own invoice; 404 for a missing file; 403 for another account.

items.title: Download button in the invoice drawer
items.criteria: The button downloads the PDF and shows an error toast when the API fails.

items.title: Tests for both
items.criteria: API and UI tests pass in CI.

three-items.note: Split by surface so the API and the web client can move in parallel.

items.title: Statement API endpoint
items.criteria: returns opening/closing balances over the chosen range; 8 endpoint tests green; malformed, missing, and reversed date ranges return 400; draft invoices are excluded from issued totals; inclusive boundaries verified end to end

items.title: Statements dashboard page
items.criteria: renders seeded data for Ada / Northgate; empty + error states covered

items.title: Statement totals reconcile
items.criteria: running balance matches invoices minus payments for the range

items.title: Verification pass
items.criteria: tester confirms page renders with live API data

items.title: Schema: add invoices.pdf_generated_at
items.criteria: Migration applies cleanly on an empty database and on the seeded one; rollback drops only the new column.

items.title: Worker: regenerate missing statements
items.criteria: A nightly job finds invoices with a null pdf_key, renders the statement, uploads it under statements/<account>/<invoice>.pdf and records the key. Re-running the job makes no second upload.
items.description: The seed data ships with null keys; the first run fills them.

items.title: API: GET /invoices/:id/pdf
items.criteria: Streams the file with the billing role; 404 when there is no key; 403 for another account's invoice.

items.title: API: rate-limit the PDF route
items.criteria: More than 30 requests a minute from one account returns 429 with a Retry-After header.

items.title: Web: download button

source.text: Can the staging deploy go out before the 3pm demo? The invoice PDF change needs to be on it.
quick one — what's the status of BILL-212?
[lead] Add a PDF download to every invoice in the drawer. The statements worker already renders them; the API needs a route and the web client a button.

Three things from the customer call:

1. They want the PDF to carry the PO number in the header.
2. Statements for closed accounts should stay downloadable for seven years.
3. The March invoices show the old tariff name.

Can you look at 3 first? It is going in front of their finance team on Friday and I would rather not explain it live. Happy to pair on it after lunch if the tariff table is as confusing as I remember.
